baseline.rule: Batch 1 records remain PROPOSED; explicit current user direction may inform conflict analysis but requires normal promotion gates.

records.title: Batch 2 source corpus registration
records.assertion: Register the two curated inbound-phone extracts plus README and manifest as SOURCE_MATERIAL_ONLY; complete originals, immutable hashes, and exact extraction anchors remain absent.
promotionDependencies: Archive immutable originals and hashes.
Verify exact extraction anchors and fidelity.

records.title: Direct inbound phone specialist entry profile
records.assertion: Model a direct inbound phone specialist entry profile for callers who have not necessarily passed through a receptionist or transfer flow; hydrate known context silently and classify current intent before selecting behavior.
promotionDependencies: Verify complete source and deployed variants.
Approve session and intent state machine.

records.title: No-specialist-transfer receptionist profile
records.assertion: Model the no-AI-sales-specialist-transfer receptionist as a distinct versioned profile that must not mention or imply a downstream AI specialist; do not generalize the restriction to other receptionist variants.
promotionDependencies: Approve deterministic variant selector.
Verify optional and assumed-transfer sibling profiles.

records.title: Inbound intent and state-priority policy
records.assertion: Classify sales, support, direct action, human request, general information, and unclear intent; support, human requests, frustration, refusal, direct action, weak engagement, and natural endpoints override extended sales discovery.
promotionDependencies: Approve intent codes, transition guards, and fallback matrix.
Complete channel and compliance review.

records.title: Installed inbound identity resolution
records.assertion: Resolve installed inbound agent names and titles from customer configuration, keep Top Sales Pro and other template labels internal, and do not expose matching, CRM, workflow, field, or prompt internals.
promotionDependencies: Approve subscriber and agent-instance configuration schema.
Verify AutoCalls variable mapping.

records.title: Configured action capability gate
records.assertion: Treat quotes, estimates, appointments, intake, links, payments, callbacks, routing, workflows, tasks, messages, and summaries as candidate action families only; an action is usable solely when an authoritative runtime capability and destination contract is configured.
promotionDependencies: Inspect current AutoCalls capabilities.
Approve tool schemas, identifiers, authorization, idempotency, and fallback behavior.

records.title: Inbound sales and support handoff separation
records.assertion: Keep sales and customer-service handoff subjects, reasons, outcomes, ownership, and summaries distinct while preserving enough context for continuation without repetition.
promotionDependencies: Approve versioned handoff and summary schemas.
Approve routing ownership and acknowledgement rules.

records.title: Historical numeric sales targets
records.assertion: Preserve five-motivator and three-to-seven action-attempt ranges only as variant-specific historical evidence; they cannot override high intent, support, human request, frustration, refusal, direct action, weak engagement, or a natural endpoint.
promotionDependencies: Define evidence-based adequacy gates and acceptance corpus.
Obtain owner approval before adopting any numeric target.

records.title: Inbound field mapping normalization
records.assertion: Treat historical HighLevel fields as mapping evidence, not canonical storage; normalize contact insights, conversations, handoffs, routing, and summaries in D1 with selected CRM mirrors and prepared AutoCalls variables.
promotionDependencies: Acquire the complete field inventory and identifiers.
Approve canonical D1 schema and mirror/reconciliation rules.

records.title: Batch 2 unresolved-material gate
records.assertion: Do not finalize inbound-phone prompt components or activate actions until authoritative Project Knowledge, complete source provenance, current AutoCalls capability evidence, routing/action contracts, and required compliance material are incorporated.
promotionDependencies: Resolve all blocking Batch 2 missing-material items.
Complete independent Claude review and owner-approved promotion.

prohibitedPromotions: No record in this package is CURRENT or FINAL.
No source label or cross-batch comparison can promote a record.
No candidate action family establishes an implemented AutoCalls capability.
No numeric discovery or action-attempt target overrides stop conditions.
